messages.subject: sqrt transformation
parts:
Hey all, 

I've got a data set which has a few important, large values, and a many important small values - some negative and some positive. I want to transform the y axis as follows:

ifelse(test = x > 0, yes = sqrt(x), no = -sqrt(-x) )

I've had a look at the source, and even modified it accordingly, but when I run the transformation from R I still get the same error message. Any advice?

Thanks

Andrew

messages.author: 27710873736e0505
messages.subject: Re: sqrt transformation
parts:
Thanks for the response!

Since sending the help request I figured out how to make your own transformation. I've included a reproducible example and my solution below. 
I didn't need to edit source at all.

this is the kind of situation I was dealing with:


x1 <- sort(exp(50,rate = 1))#generating some data
#this is positive, so let's add two negative numbers
x1 <-  x1 - (x1[2]+x[3])/2
index = 1:50 #plot everybody by their rank
d <- data.frame(index, x1)

ggplot(data = d) + 
geom_segment(aes( x = index #added segments because I like how it looks
, xend = index
, y = 0
, yend = x1
))+ 
geom_point(aes(x = index #points
, y= x1 #color according whether or not this causes a problem for sqrt.
, color = ifelse(test= x1 < 0, yes = 'yep', no = 'nope') )) + 
scale_color_hue("problem?", direction = -1)



#I now realize to make a new transformation you do something like the following:
TransAllSqrt <- Trans$new("AllSqrt"
, f = function(x){  #function mapping to new values
ifelse(test = x>=0
, yes = sqrt(x)
, no = - sqrt(-x))
}
, inverse = function(x){ 
ifelse(x>0 #inverse of your transformation
, yes = x^2
, no = -(x^2))
}
, labels = function(x) ifelse(test = x>0, yes = (x)^2, no = -(-x)^2)) 
#what do you want to do with the labels? 
#then you'd use trans = "AllSqrt" inside of scale continuous.

ggplot(data = d) + 
geom_segment(aes( x = index #added segments because I like how it looks
, xend = index
, y = 0
, yend = x1
))+ 
geom_point(aes(x = index #points
, y= x1 #color according whether or not this causes a problem for sqrt.
, color = "no problems." )) + 
scale_color_hue("problem?")+
scale_y_continuous(trans = 'AllSqrt')
#this produces NA's Because of how ifelse works, but plots just find. Use Hadley's implementation 
#to avoid NA's.
